title: Cross-customer k-fold relevance harness & live NDCG/MRR signal plumbing
creator: Priya Natarajan
description: Overview: Build a reusable k-fold evaluation harness and live telemetry plumbing to track NDCG and MRR per-customer and per-promptset, enable stratified sampling for offline evals, and add lightweight A/B hooks on the reranking endpoint for experiment gating. This ticket covers the eval harness, schema changes for signal ingestion, a reference Jupyter/Notion notebook for analysts, and a plan for a gradual rollout with canary A/B tests. Goals: 1) Produce consistent offline NDCG/MRR scores across customer prompt sets and model variants; 2) Surface live NDCG/MRR baselines in the Console and tie regression alerts to prompt sets; 3) Ensure reranker endpoint changes do not degrade P95 latency beyond 10ms and scale to 500 QPS with batching; 4) Provide simple experiment flags for product teams to run canary comparisons with minimal infra changes.
acceptance_criteria: k-fold harness runs on both synthetic and three customer promptset fixtures and produces reproducible NDCG@10 and MRR@10 scores
telemetry schema v2 accepted by ingestion pipeline: includes request_id, customer_id, promptset_id, candidate_scores, gold_ranks, model_version, latency_ms
Console dashboard updated with per-promptset NDCG/MRR timeseries and scatter view for model comparisons
Rerank endpoint supports 'X-Rerank-Experiment' header and records experiment_id in telemetry events
Benchmarks show end-to-end P95 latency increase <= 10ms for 1-10 candidate rerank call and service scales to 500 QPS with batching enabled
A/B rollout runbook documented and tested in staging with rollback verified
implementation_notes: Eval harness: implement stratified k-fold to preserve click-rate/click-sparsity distributions per customer; default k=5 but parameterized
Data fixtures: convert three anonymized customer promptsets to canonical TSV with columns: query, candidates(json list), gold_rank_index
Offline runner: python harness that accepts model variants and outputs NDCG@k, MRR@k, recall@k with per-fold breakdown and overall CI via bootstrapping
Telemetry: extend existing rerank event schema to include candidate_scores array and gold_ranks. Use protobuf schema change with backfill script for staging dashboards
Endpoint hooks: add optional 'X-Rerank-Experiment' header and propagate to logging/telemetry. Implement experiment routing in smart-routing layer to allow shadow/canary variants
Performance: implement micro-batching at the rerank service boundary (merge up to N requests with collated candidate sets) and KV-cache for candidate embeddings to reduce recompute
Security/PII: customer promptsets used for offline evals must be anonymized; no raw user IDs in attachments; KMS keys used for any stored datasets
updates: 2025-02-16: Initial design review with PM and Data Science. Agreed to use k-fold + bootstrapping for confidence intervals. Decision to prioritize NDCG@10 and MRR@10.
2025-02-20: Prototype harness completed for synthetic dataset; observed variance between folds higher than expected for low-activity promptsets. Added stratified sampling to preserve click sparsity.
2025-02-27: Telemetry schema v2 proposal posted in #infra-telemetry. Diego opened PR to add candidate_scores field to rerank_event proto (PR: github.com/redwood/re-rank/pull/332).
2025-03-02: Performance micro-batching spike test in staging: batching factor 4 reduced CPU usage 18% but added 6ms median latency. Iterating on batching window and boundary conditions.
2025-03-05: Console dashboard mockups reviewed with DX. Data team to wire daily aggregations; alerting thresholds TBD. Preparing staging canary for week of 2025-03-10.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: High variance in small promptsets leads to noisy signals. Mitigation: require minimum sample size per promptset (n>=200) and aggregate low-volume promptsets into 'long-tail' group for signal stability.

Risk: Telemetry payload size increase (candidate_scores array) impacts ingestion cost. Mitigation: compress arrays, sample candidates for low-value traffic, and add storage retention policy for raw events.
Risk: Batching increases P95 latency for latency-sensitive customers. Mitigation: per-customer routing policy to disable batching for latency-SLO customers and offer synchronous fallback option.
Risk: Experiment header misuse leading to skewed traffic. Mitigation: enforce experiment registry and require experiments to be declared before enabling production traffic.
testing_plan: Unit tests for k-fold harness and stratified sampling logic
Integration tests for telemetry schema changes and ingest pipeline in staging
Load tests simulating 100, 250, 500 QPS with realistic candidate set sizes (3-20) and measuring P50/P95/P99 latency and resource usage
A/B test smoke in staging: run two reranker variants behind experiment header for 48h, compare NDCG/MRR and latency, validate rollback path
notes: Do not load raw customer PII into shared staging buckets. Use anonymized fixtures maintained by Data Security.
Follow-up ticket needed to add automatic regression alerts based on sliding-window NDCG drop > 5% per promptset
Consider future work: per-candidate calibration, learned reweighting by promptset, and candidate-level bias diagnostics
